description.value: Executive Inn Whistler is a boutique hotel situated directly on Village Stroll in the heart of Whistler Village, part of the Executive Hotels & Resorts group. The property markets itself as a year-round adventure base with amenities including a heated outdoor pool, cardio fitness centre, and secure ski and bike storage. Its central village location gives touring cyclists immediate access to Whistler's trail network, restaurants, and services.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website amenities page explicitly lists 'Secure Ski & Bike Storage' confirming secure overnight bike storage. Wi-Fi is listed both in OSM tags (internet_access=wlan) and the amenities page ('Wi-Fi Internet Access'). The dining page references affiliated restaurants (Trattoria di Como, Il Caminetto) and the hotel's Village Stroll location in Whistler Village supports nearby evening food; no explicit evidence exists for laundry, drying area, pump, tools, bike wash, or e-bike charging (an EV car charging station is mentioned but not specified for e-bikes).
concerns: An EV charging station is listed on the amenities page but is not described as accessible for e-bikes; e-bike charging eligibility cannot be confirmed without further inquiry.
OSM address omits postal code (V0N 1B4) present on the website; address updated to include it.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established Whistler Village hotel with explicitly confirmed secure bike storage, Wi-Fi, and a central location on the Village Stroll — a clear fit for touring cyclists needing overnight accommodation in Whistler.

Secure overnight bike storage.detail: Amenities page explicitly lists 'Secure Ski & Bike Storage' as a hotel amenity

Nearby evening food.detail: Hotel dining page references affiliated on-site/nearby restaurants Trattoria di Como and Il Caminetto; hotel is also located in Whistler Village with abundant surrounding dining

Wi-Fi.detail: Amenities page lists 'Wi-Fi Internet Access'. Described as 'high speed wi-fi' in the hotel amenity fee section

price.signal: Whistler Village boutique hotel; in-room fireplace, luxury robes, pool/hot tub, full-service amenities
